chairs.name: 谢天
chairs.bio: 谢天，本科毕业于中国科学技术大学，现就职于 Qwen。专注于预训练模型架构及其训练优化算法研究，希望通过算法侧改进提升智能上限。 个人主页

talk.title: Controlled LLM Training on Spectral Sphere
talk.speaker: 胡译文
talk.affiliation: 中国人民大学 · 高瓴人工智能学院
talk.abstract: Scaling large models requires optimization strategies that ensure rapid convergence grounded in stability. Maximal Update Parametrization (μP) provides a theoretical safeguard for width-invariant Θ(1) activation control, whereas emerging optimizers like Muon are only half-aligned with these constraints: they control updates but allow weights to drift. To address this limitation, we introduce the Spectral Sphere Optimizer (SSO), which enforces strict module-wise spectral constraints on both weights and their updates. By deriving the steepest descent direction on the spectral sphere, SSO realizes a fully μP-aligned optimization process. To enable large-scale training, we implement SSO as an efficient parallel algorithm within Megatron. Through extensive pretraining on diverse architectures, including Dense 1.7B, MoE 8B-A1B, and 200-layer DeepNet models, SSO consistently outperforms AdamW and Muon. Furthermore, we observe significant practical stability benefits, including improved MoE router load balancing, suppressed outliers, and strictly bounded activations.

paper.abstract: Scaling large models requires optimization strategies that ensure rapid convergence grounded in stability. Maximal Update Parametrization ($\boldsymbolμ$P) provides a theoretical safeguard for width-invariant $Θ(1)$ activation control, whereas emerging optimizers like Muon are only ``half-aligned'' with these constraints: they control updates but allow weights to drift. To address this limitation, we introduce the \textbf{Spectral Sphere Optimizer (SSO)}, which enforces strict module-wise spectral constraints on both weights and their updates. By deriving the steepest descent direction on the spectral sphere, SSO realizes a fully $\boldsymbolμ$P-aligned optimization process. To enable large-scale training, we implement SSO as an efficient parallel algorithm within Megatron. Through extensive pretraining on diverse architectures, including Dense 1.7B, MoE 8B-A1B, and 200-layer DeepNet models, SSO consistently outperforms AdamW and Muon. Furthermore, we observe significant practical stability benefits, including improved MoE router load balancing, suppressed outliers, and strictly bounded activations.

short_read:
**问题**：（对应论文为自动检索推断，可能有偏差）大模型预训练需要稳定前提下的快速收敛。μP 理论上保证激活尺度 $\Theta(1)$，但 Muon 只约束更新、不约束权重，导致权重漂移与激活异常；现有做法靠 SandwichNorm、QK-Norm 等架构补丁强行稳定，牺牲表达力且调参成本高。报告要解决的问题是：能否构造一个同时满足最速下降与严格 μP 约束的优化器，从优化器层面根治不稳定？

**核心方法**：提出 Spectral Sphere Optimizer (SSO)。对权重 $W\in\mathbb{R}^{d_{\text{out}}\times d_{\text{in}}}$，令谱半径 $R=\Theta(\sqrt{d_{\text{out}}/d_{\text{in}}})$，更新 $\Delta W=\eta R\Phi$，其中 $\Phi$ 在谱球切平面内最大化 $\langle G,\Phi\rangle$ 且满足 $\langle\Theta,\Phi\rangle=0$（$\Theta=u_1v_1^\top$）。通过 Lagrange 乘子 $\lambda$ 搜索，$\Phi^*(\lambda)=\operatorname{msign}(G+\lambda\Theta)$，用 bracketing+bisection 求 $h(\lambda)=\langle\Theta,\operatorname{msign}(G+\lambda\Theta)\rangle$ 的根，并加 retraction 投影回谱球。在 Megatron 中实现原子模块分片、ping-pong 负载均衡、自适应 kernel 与多流并行。实验覆盖 Dense 1.7B、MoE 8B-A1B、200 层 DeepNet，均优于 AdamW 和 Muon，且改善 MoE 路由均衡、抑制 outlier、激活严格有界。

**与已有工作的关系**：SSO 直接推进 μP（Yang et al., 2024）的谱条件，补上 Muon（Jordan et al., 2024）缺失的权重约束。与 Scion（Pethick et al., 2025）及 MuonSphere（$\lambda=0$ 变体）相比，SSO 通过 $\lambda$ 搜索实现真正的切空间最速下降，而非简单归一化。实验还显示 SSO 在 μP 宽度扩展下学习率迁移更稳，且可去掉隐藏层权重衰减，减少一个超参数。

**贡献与边界**：主要贡献是给出一个完全 μP 对齐的优化器，兼具理论推导、分布式实现和跨架构验证。边界：论文为自动检索匹配，细节可能有偏差；SSO 每步比 Muon 慢 11.45%（表 2），CPU 端二分求解器带来同步开销；谱半径常数 $c$ 需人工调节（$c=2.0$ 最佳）；方法只作用于 2D 权重，embedding 仍用权重衰减。官网摘要未给出完整实验设置，泛化性仍需更多任务验证。
